name: AI Tools Pin

sources.title: Homepage — AI tools directory; nav links to Submit Tool and Advertise
Submit Your AI Tool — required JSON field format, manual review, 3-5 business day response

requirements: Tool must be functional and publicly accessible
Submitter must have the right to submit the tool
Submissions accepted only in the exact JSON format shown on the page (id, name, image, category, price, description, features, use_cases, likes, dislikes, tags, url)
Category must match one of the site's existing categories (Advertising, AI Assistants, Code, SEO, Writing, etc.)
Price must be exactly one of: Free, Freemium, Paid
Manual review before listing; page states both '48 hours' review and '3-5 business days' response
preparation: Tool name, URL, and a unique lowercase-hyphenated id
2-3 sentence description of purpose and benefits
5-10 key features and 5-10 use cases as arrays
Logo/icon image (PNG preferred) and an interface screenshot
Matching category from the site's fixed list
workflow: Compose the tool record in the exact JSON schema published on submit-tool.html
Open https://aitoolspin.com/submit-tool.html and use the embedded submission form (renders via 'Loading submission form...' widget)
Wait for manual review; the site says it contacts you within 3-5 business days
watchFor: Directory is very small (homepage shows only ~15 tools) — likely a low-traffic side project
Contradictory review windows on the same page (48 hours vs 3-5 business days)
Field names in 'Required JSON Format' and 'Field Requirements' sections disagree (features vs key_features, use_cases counts) — follow the JSON example literally
Embedded form did not render in the fetched text — the actual form endpoint is unverified
Separate 'Advertise' page exists; paid promotion is distinct from the free listing route
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the directory grid on aitoolspin.com with its card (name, category, price tag) and its URL is reachable from the listing
unknowns: Underlying form provider and whether the embedded form still works
Actual review turnaround and acceptance rate
Whether listings include a dofollow link
